summary: Diplomatic negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz are entering a new phase, with US officials reporting progress. Concurrently, Yemen has conducted a UAV strike against a sensitive target at the Najran airport in Saudi Arabia. These developments occur amid reports of increased maritime tension and potential agreements to clear mines in the Strait.
key_points: Iran and Oman are conducting technical and political talks to establish safe transit routes for ships in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @SharghDaily/176226).
Yemen carried out a UAV strike against a sensitive target at the Najran airport in Saudi Arabia (Source: @kianmeli1/90617).
US Secretary of State Rubio reported progress in talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @yediotnews25/133583).
A vessel was reportedly hit near the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @yediotnews25/133569).
The Yemeni armed forces stated the Najran strike was a response to airspace violations in Saada and Hajjah (Source: @kianmeli1/90617).
Iran is considering allowing European nations to clear mines from the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @amitsegal/63642).
Saudi Arabia is attempting to communicate with the Houthis through Oman to avoid escalation (Source: @asafroz/52239).
The US Army has reportedly exhausted nearly all its ATACMS and PrSM stockpiles during the five-month war with Iran (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6049).

sections.executive_summary: Diplomatic negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz are entering a new phase, with US officials reporting progress. Concurrently, Yemen has conducted a UAV strike against a sensitive target at the Najran airport in Saudi Arabia. These developments occur amid reports of increased maritime tension and potential agreements to clear mines in the Strait.

points: Iran and Oman are engaged in technical and political negotiations to determine safe transit routes for vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, aiming to balance sovereignty with national security (Source: @SharghDaily/176226).

The proposed Hormuz plan with Oman would grant Iran total authority over all inbound maritime traffic, requiring Oman to notify Iranian officials before clearing outbound vessels (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6047).
Iran is considering a plan to allow European nations to assist in clearing mines from the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @amitsegal/63642).
Negotiations regarding the Hormuz corridor are entering a new phase, with Iranian officials stating the talks show determination to safeguard their rights (Source: @presstv/201597).
Unidentified smoke was observed rising from the South Tehran refinery in Shahre Rey (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78746).
The Shin Bet arrested an illegal settler from the West Bank on suspicion of spying for Iranian intelligence agencies and collecting sensitive information (Source: @presstv/201592).
The IDF arrested a member of the 'Lions' Den' terrorist organization in the Shechem casbah during anti-terror operations (Source: @inon_yttach/9809).
Four soldiers remaining in the Givati brigade were sentenced following a mutiny, with three receiving 30-day prison sentences and immediate removal from combat service (Source: @inon_yttach/9805).
US officials have sent a draft regarding Gaza that Israel has not yet accepted (Source: @rasedaladado138e/382864).
The Gaza Government Media Office reported 1,252 martyrs resulting from 4,000 Israeli violations of the ceasefire agreement (Source: @rasedaladado138e/382857).
The Iraqi PMU has mobilized massive security forces to ensure the security of the Arbaeen procession (Source: @presstv/201575).
Iraq has stated it will strike militias loyal to Iran if they attack Jordan (Source: @naya_foriraq/86915).
Saudi Arabia is attempting to use Oman to communicate with the Houthis to prevent escalation, while simultaneously preparing for military action if talks fail (Source: @asafroz/52239).
A UAV strike targeted a sensitive location at the Najran airport in Saudi Arabia (Source: @kianmeli1/90617).
Unconfirmed reports indicate a potential UAV strike on Kuwait (Source: @shin_persian/8803).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains highly volatile due to simultaneous kinetic and diplomatic pressures. The potential for maritime conflict in the Strait of Hormuz is high, as Iran seeks total authority over inbound traffic. Furthermore, the depletion of US missile stockpiles like ATACMS suggests a significant shift in long-term military readiness and deterrence capabilities.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are employing diverse strategies, with Saudi Arabia using Omani mediation to prevent escalation with the Houthis. Iran is leveraging diplomatic engagement through Oman to secure maritime rights, while the US is attempting to facilitate agreements to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported depletion of US ATACMS and PrSM stockpiles is a critical indicator of the intensity of the ongoing conflict with Iran. Additionally, the focus on the Strait of Hormuz as a primary diplomatic and operational lever highlights its central importance to regional stability and global energy security.
